about_short_description.short_description: Blue Onion Labs produces software that enables tracing of transactions and reconciliation of orders.

identifier.value: Order-to-Cash Reconciliation

product.name: Order-to-Cash Reconciliation
product.description: Automates the reconciliation of sales orders to payments and bank settlements, providing a unified view of transactions from point of sale to bank deposit.

identifier.value: Transaction-Level Reconciliation

product.name: Transaction-Level Reconciliation
product.description: Performs detailed reconciliation on individual transactions using machine learning algorithms to ensure data accuracy and completeness.

identifier.value: Revenue Recognition

product.name: Revenue Recognition
product.description: Automates revenue recognition processes in compliance with accounting standards, handling complexities like multiple shipments and deferred revenue.

identifier.value: Accounts Receivable Subledger

product.name: Accounts Receivable Subledger
product.description: Tracks and consolidates order, billing, payment, and bank payout data into a single view for accurate reporting and auditing.

identifier.value: Cash-in-Transit

product.name: Cash-in-Transit
product.description: Provides visibility into pending cash transactions and verifies key balance sheet accounts related to cash flow.

identifier.value: Automated Journal Entries

product.name: Automated Journal Entries
product.description: Automatically generates journal entries from reconciled financial data to reduce manual effort in financial reporting.
